table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,   
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
         accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
		 custalias=accounts.aliasname,
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
		 custarea=(select  name from area where area.areacode=customer.areacode),
		custliscno=customer.licenceno,  
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = saleledger.headerno,   
         date =  Case :ai_printdate When 1 Then saleledger.originaldate When 2 Then saleledger.date When 3 Then saleledger.Billingdate  End, 
         invdiscperc = saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax =saleledger.salestax,   
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = saledetail.batch,   
         expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
         looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
         bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
         packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
         packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
		 source_saleprice=(select isnull(max(saleprice),0) from saledetail AS ParentSD where ParentSD.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and ParentSD.icode=saledetail.icode),
      	 source_invotal=(select dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(saleledger.saleinvcode) ),  
		 discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
         salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
         Id = saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=0,   
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			custref=saleledger.custrefno,	
			remarks=saleledger.remarks,
			printwaranty=saleledger.printwaranty,
			printbatch=saleledger.printbatch,
			reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
			serverdate=getdate(),
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
			messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode)

    FROM saleledgermodified saleledger,   
         saledetailmodified saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE (saleledger.saleinvcode IN (Select SaleInvCode From SaleLedgerModified Where SaleInvCode Between :ar_SInvCode And :ar_LInvCode And :ar_dateorinv = 0 ) 
	OR
		saleledger.saleinvcode IN (Select SaleInvCode From SaleLedgerModified Where Date Between :ar_StartDate And :ar_EndDate And :ar_dateorinv = 1 ) 				
	) AND  
	( saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode) )AND  
         ( saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
			saleledgerl.saleinvcode,
			saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
